item.title: Instead of building concrete walls, nature already invented …
item.author: Petra Michaela (@petramichaela.bsky.social)
item.description: Instead of building concrete walls, nature already invented the perfect coastal defense. Mangrove roots form a tangled web that catches crashing waves and breaks them down into gentle currents. They stop erosion, filter our water, and save entire coastal communities from flooding.
